criteria.description: Works in one of the industries DEPLOY has served: energy, consulting, venture capital, finance, HR tech, education, or enterprise software.

Has 50 to 5,000 employees (a strict range, no margin): big enough to have a dev team and a workflow owner, small enough to need outside AI help. Prefer the company's own statement of headcount (about page, careers page, press release). Use a third-party workforce estimate only if the company states nothing itself. If sources disagree, the company's own figure wins.
Has an engineering or IT team, e.g. engineering job posts, a tech blog, or a product they build.
Is building or adopting AI in any form: open AI/ML/automation roles, an announced AI pilot, AI mentioned as a company priority, or AI features in its own product (e.g. integrations with OpenAI).
Uses tools DEPLOY works with (Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Power BI, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), seen in job posts or case studies.
Has high-volume operations: a dedicated support, claims or onboarding team, or a stated volume (e.g. tickets or claims per month).
AI services or AI agents are the main product the company sells. A company selling an 'AI-powered' product in another category is not excluded.
The company is a big tech company with large in-house AI research teams.
